description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A long flexible woven strip ends in two broad straight bound borders. Side: Its thin layered profile rests flat with a slight natural curvature. Rear: The reverse face exposes the continuous interlacing and tied border ends. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of this exact product. Generate ONE side catalog photo of the SAME object by camera movement only: camera orbits exactly 90 degrees to the object's RIGHT side; for the long runner it faces a NARROW SHORT END with the length receding away. Keep the thin flexible table runner lying perfectly FLAT on the floor, with slender woven edge binding only, no raised frame, tubular rails, corner posts or legs. Do not lift or stand it upright. Use the same modest downward elevation as the front so the upper weave remains visible. Preserve exact length, width, ring diameters, fiber pattern, deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain, trim and binding positions. Show previously unseen edge surfaces without changing the design. Whole object centered with generous margins on the same warm-white studio background. No text, numbers, logos, labels, props, extra products, collage or borders.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
